Our Heritage

One counter, 147 years of Lahore mornings

S. Mohkam-Ud-Din and Sons has been baking at Nila Gumbad, in the middle of Anarkali Bazaar, since 1879 — long enough for grandparents to bring their grandchildren to the same counter they grew up with.

The name is known across the city for its wedding and Christmas cakes and for Lady Harrison's finger biscuits — the biscuits Lahore's tea tables have asked for by name for as long as anyone can remember.

Anarkali has changed around it many times over. The bakery, at 7 Nila Gumbad near the Anarkali crossing, is still where it has always been — doing what it has always done.
